svg.title: Transformer encoder and decoder layers
svg.desc: Encoder layer: multi-head self-attention, Add and Norm, feed-forward, Add and Norm, each with a residual skip. Decoder layer: masked multi-head self-attention, Add and Norm, cross-attention whose K and V come from the encoder output, Add and Norm, feed-forward, Add and Norm. Every arrow carries T_k x 512 in the encoder and T_q x 512 in the decoder. Each stack has 6 layers.
svg.text: Q from decoder, K and V from Xenc​
